title: docs/vouching.md: what vouching for a real person means
description: Shared reference: what an endorsement asserts (this key and these emails belong to this real, named person), acceptable evidence (met in person with ID, video call, long verifiable collaboration), what not to endorse (someone you only know online by handle), what to write in the note, and how approvers use endorsements to appoint someone to a tier (approver above the tier, reads endorsements, decides; no minimum count). Includes cross-community endorsements (alsoKnownAs, same did:key). The evidence standard is a kernel-community policy call: draft with recommendations and flag it for Mark/kernel review.
acceptance_criteria: Every claim matches DESIGN.md; policy recommendations clearly marked as proposals for kernel review.
notes: Drafted docs/vouching.md. Policy (evidence standard, key/email confirmation, note content, approver checklist, GPG-draft signing) marked 'Proposal for kernel review'. Review fixes: swapped-key carry-over risk, revoke-not-retire on doubt, approver check for unsigned-key-change WARNING, draft subjectKey/subjectName confirmation. Commands quoted but not yet implemented: git vouch endorse/approve, and git-vouch-migrate drafts --as (vouch-omzm.3). Open: no endorsement-withdrawal mechanism in DESIGN.md; 'git vouch did' rejects .pub paths (doc uses "$(cat KEY.pub)").
